paragraphs.text: The Cozen is an Orzhov assassin on Ravnica , whose true identity is unknown. At one point he was on an Azorius list of the ten most wanted criminals.

The Cozen was accused of misinterpreting his paid Orzhov contracts to justify his murderous ways, such as counting the "head" as a valid form of "limb" to claim from a victim. The Cozen was also known to bribe Azorius officials and illegally acquire a detention sphere, which he converted into a pain-infliction device.
